root_cause_label: Output Format Mismatch (Missing Quotes Around Winning Items) + Premature Submission Despite Known Formatting Defect
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote a script that formatted winning-hand entries without required quotes (e.g., { Winning hand - Standard } instead of { "Winning hand - Standard" }), and submitted the defective result.txt without correcting the visible formatting error.
t_err_evidence: results.append(f"{filename}: {{ {pattern_str} }}") with pattern_str joining items unquoted
t_commit_evidence: Once the script is written and executed in step 5 without any intervening correction, the incorrectly-formatted result.txt is produced; from this point the agent only reads and manually spot-checks inputs, never modifying the format, locking in the failing output.
t_surface_evidence: hand_001.json: { Winning hand - Seven Pairs, Winning hand - Standard }
trigger_explanation: The agent never consulted or verified what exact format (including quoting style) the benchmark expected for winning-hand entries. It invented a plausible-looking format `{ Winning hand - X }` instead of the required `{ "Winning hand - X" }`, and then never checked the spec again to notice the mismatch.
